gap_identified.description: The rest-state fit was fully clean (0 inside verts, 0 overlap pairs, both garments), but at a single fixed posed stride (thigh +-8-12deg) the skirt showed 1837-1838 inside verts up to 56.3mm deep and 883 body-overlap-pairs; the shirt also degraded to 110 inside verts / 582 pairs / 10.35mm deep. Root cause per insight 75266: apply_outfit.py on character-foundry rejects any vertex group that is not a G9 rig bone, so provider-authored secondary/spring bones cannot enter through assets.outfit -- the skirt/shirt are limited to smoothed pelvis/spine/thigh-twist G9-bone weights, which is a rest-pose-only correction with no live pose-following margin.
gap_identified.reproduction_note: Independently reproduced byte-for-byte against the recorded task-133870.blend (sha256 fe123af8...66cb, matches evidence exactly) before any change: skirt inside_verts_normal_test=1837, ray_parity=1838, max_depth_mm=56.296, body_overlap_pairs=883; shirt inside_verts=110/110, max_depth_mm=10.351, body_overlap_pairs=582 -- exact match to task-133870-evidence.json posed_stride_limit.

fix_applied.summary: A masked, pose-general corrective SHRINKWRAP(OUTSIDE_SURFACE) modifier added after the Armature modifier on the skirt (and, more conservatively, the shirt), restricted by a vertex group to the hem/thigh-adjacent band identified from the rest-pose body distance, plus local mesh subdivision in that band so per-vertex nearest-surface projection cannot leave a large triangle straddling the body's curvature. This does NOT touch apply_outfit.py or the G9 armature (the insight-75266 contract gap is a separate, unfixed item); it is a garment-side geometric correction that works within the existing G9-bone-only weighting constraint and is live at ANY pose, not baked to one fixed stride angle.
fix_applied.not_in_scope: The insight-75266 apply_outfit.py provider-bone-merge gap itself is NOT closed by this task -- that would require a character-foundry code change on a different host/repo. This task closes the OBSERVABLE symptom (posed interpenetration) via a garment-geometry corrective that works inside the existing constraint.

shirt.note: kept deliberately conservative after wider masks/offsets caused shrinkwrap NEAREST_SURFACEPOINT to misproject across the armpit fold at large arm rotation and made the shoulder region worse (see honest_residuals) -- the shirt was never the 'second garment type' subject of step 15 and this task does not claim it clean.

pose_definitions.posed_B_stride: independent stride: l_thigh 10deg, r_thigh -8deg, spine1 twist

verification.skirt_verdict: PARTIAL PASS: the severe, visually-obvious defect (leg piercing the skirt front, up to 56mm deep, 1838 vertices) is fully eliminated -- inside_verts_normal_test (the sound per-vertex gate) and max_depth_mm are exactly 0 at rest and all 3 independent posed frames. body_overlap_pairs (insight 56023's stricter per-TRIANGLE sound gate, which catches a triangle slicing the body with all 3 corners individually outside) is reduced 43-71% (883 -> 252-500) but not driven to exact zero; the residual is thin tangential triangle-grazing at the hem boundary curve, confirmed visually invisible in the rendered proof (see renders) -- not the leg-through-fabric defect the gap named.
verification.shirt_verdict: NOT claimed fixed at posed_A. The shirt's pose-A defect is at the LEFT SHOULDER/ARMPIT (world Z 1.31-1.38m, not the hip/thigh region the skirt gap was about), driven by an 18deg l_upperarm rotation folding the sleeve into the armpit. Wider corrective masks/offsets were tried and made this WORSE (up to 2510 inside verts) because SHRINKWRAP NEAREST_SURFACEPOINT misprojects across a tight concave fold, snapping to the wrong side of the crease; a PROJECT-mode second pass was also tried and also regressed the rest-state gate. The shirt was kept at a conservative, near-baseline correction (clean at 2 of 3 posed frames, unchanged-or-improved at the 3rd vs. the original 110/582/10.35mm) rather than risk making a real defect worse. This is a genuinely distinct defect from the skirt/insight-75266 gap and is left honestly unresolved.
verification.weights_unchanged: both garments remain 100% weighted+normalized on their original G9 bone groups (verified after adding the corrective, excluding the new posed_corrective_mask helper group from the weight sum)

visual_proof.observation: posed_A_front/side renders show NO visible leg-through-skirt penetration at the recorded stride pose (the defect the FAIL was about); the hem shows a mildly irregular/scalloped edge from the local subdivision+shrinkwrap correction, an honest cosmetic trade-off, not a penetration.

next_step_recommendation: Leave ledger step 725908/15 done_unverified for a fresh cross-provider re-check of this narrower claim (skirt posed vertex-inside/depth clean at 3 poses; skirt triangle-overlap pairs reduced not zeroed; shirt pose-A armpit defect distinct and still open). A full zero on skirt body_overlap_pairs and a fix for the shirt armpit fold both look like they need true cloth relaxation (a short Warp/Blender collision-relaxation pass seeded from these posed frames) rather than further static shrinkwrap tuning -- matching the original task-133870 'Honest limits' note that walking needs cloth sim or spring chains, and separately, the insight-75266 apply_outfit.py provider-bone gap remains open as unrelated follow-on work on the character-foundry side.
